visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use pure white cards on slate-50 background for clean separation. No heavy glassmorphism for health/finance to keep data legible.

layouts.container: max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-slate-50 flex flex-col
layouts.bento_insurance: grid grid-cols-2 gap-4. Primary metric (Sum Assured) spans full width, smaller metrics (Premium, Years) span 1 column.

components.pin_keypad: Grid of rounded-full buttons. text-2xl font-medium. Minimalist, no borders, just subtle hover/active background (bg-slate-200). Use lucide-react for backspace.
components.vault_card: Flex row layout. Left: Icon (Bank, Social, etc.) in a rounded-lg soft background. Middle: Title + Subtitle (Username). Right: Copy password button (ghost variant).
components.insurance_card: Similar to vault card but includes badge for 'Policy Term' and highlights 'Premium' amount.
components.tabs: Pill-shaped tabs for categories. Active tab gets bg-slate-900 text-white, inactive gets bg-slate-100 text-slate-600.
components.password_input: Input with trailing icon for visibility toggle (Eye/EyeOff) and copy button.
components.fab: Floating Action Button fixed bottom-right. Large rounded-full, primary color, shadow-lg, Plus icon.
components.toast: Use sonner for copy confirmations. e.g., 'Password copied to clipboard'

motion.click: Active states must slightly scale down (active:scale-95) for tactile feedback.
motion.route_transition: Simple fade-in or slide-up. Keep it snappy.
motion.pin_entry: Staggered fade for the dots representing entered digits.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially text-slate-500, passes APCA/WCAG. No grey-on-grey.
accessibility.aria: Add aria-label to icon-only buttons (copy, view password).

testing_attributes.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only where appropriate, but prefer solid clean surfaces for data-heavy apps like this.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx.
